_comment: BLOCKER 2 -- THE PROOF CASE, reproduced verbatim from the adversarial reviewer's execution. The cro lane is configured with expects_brain_search:false in the shipped registry (as cpo also was). Under round-1 code, evaluateLane() branched around assertRoomSet() entirely for such a lane and emitted a SKIP, and SKIPs do not affect the exit code -- so this observation set, in which a cro-lane brain_search searched BOTH attorney-privileged personal-legal rooms, PASSED. One line of config silently deleted the single most important assertion in the file. This fixture must FAIL with a P0 ring violation, and the accompanying locking test asserts that expects_brain_search can never again suppress the forbidden-room half.
